# x402cloud.ai

OpenAI-compatible AI inference that agents pay for per call in USDC over the x402 standard. No signup, no API keys — payment is authentication. Testnet only: Base Sepolia (`eip155:84532`).

## Overview

The product is metered inference. `infer.x402cloud.ai` serves OpenAI-compatible chat, embedding and image endpoints. There is no subscription: each call settles its own metered cost. Text models meter on tokens, embeddings meter on request characters, and image generation is a flat per-image price — see Pricing below.

- **Inference API** — `https://infer.x402cloud.ai`, OpenAI wire format, 8 models on 8 short-name routes plus 3 OpenAI-compatible routes
- **Metered payment (`upto`)** — the client authorizes a ceiling; settlement moves only the metered cost
- **Open-source rail** — 5 npm packages implementing x402 v2, MIT licensed
- **Hosted facilitator** — verification and USDC settlement at `facilitator.x402cloud.ai`; any conformant facilitator also works

Current network: **Base Sepolia (`eip155:84532`) only** — confirmed by `GET https://facilitator.x402cloud.ai/supported`, which returns `{"schemes":["exact","upto"],"networks":["eip155:84532"],...}`. All amounts settle in Base Sepolia test USDC (`0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e`). Base mainnet is not served today.

Standards conformance: 402 responses follow the Linux Foundation x402 v2 specification (`x402Version: 2`, CAIP-2 networks, `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header). The price appears as both `amount` (the spec's name) and `maxAmount` (this implementation's original name), carrying the same value, so stock clients — `@x402/fetch`, Cloudflare Agents SDK — can read an offer without special-casing.

## How x402 Works

The x402 protocol adds payment negotiation to standard HTTP using the `402 Payment Required` status code:

1. **Request** — Agent sends a normal HTTP request to a paid endpoint
2. **402 Response** — Server returns HTTP 402. The JSON body is the `PaymentRequired` object (`x402Version`, `resource`, `accepts[]`). The same object, base64-encoded, is also in the `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` response header. Each `accepts[]` entry carries `scheme`, `network`, `asset`, `amount` and `maxAmount` (identical values), `payTo`, `maxTimeoutSeconds`, `extra.facilitator`
3. **Sign & Retry** — Client signs a Permit2 USDC authorization (no on-chain tx yet) and retries the request with the base64 payload in the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` request header. The legacy name `X-PAYMENT` is still accepted on the request
4. **Verify** — Server-side middleware sends the payment payload to the facilitator for verification
5. **Process** — If valid, the server processes the request normally
6. **Settle** — After a successful response, the middleware calls the facilitator to settle the payment on-chain via Permit2 transfer, and returns the settled amount in the `X-Payment-Settled` response header

Key properties:
- **Metered (upto) payments**: Client authorizes a max amount, pays only for the amount the service's `meter()` reports (never more than authorized)
- **No pre-funding**: Permit2 authorizations are signed off-chain, funds only move on settlement
- **Atomic**: Payment settles only after successful service delivery
- **Stateless**: No sessions, no accounts, no databases — just HTTP headers

## Live Services

### infer.x402cloud.ai — Metered AI Inference

OpenAI-compatible AI inference with x402 micropayments. Runs on Cloudflare Workers AI.

- **Base URL**: `https://infer.x402cloud.ai`
- **Format**: OpenAI chat completions API (non-streaming — see Limits below)
- **Payment**: x402 upto scheme, USDC on Base Sepolia (`eip155:84532`)
- **Recipient**: `0x207C6D8f63Bf01F70dc6D372693E8D5943848E88`
- **Service docs**: https://infer.x402cloud.ai/llms.txt
- **Models list**: https://infer.x402cloud.ai/models

#### Available Models

`maxPrice` is the ceiling the 402 asks the client to authorize, not the charge. Authoritative live values: `GET https://infer.x402cloud.ai/models`.

| Endpoint | Model | Type | maxPrice (ceiling) | Description |
|----------|-------|------|--------------------|-------------|
| POST /nano | @cf/ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-micro | text | $0.000277 | Fastest, simple tasks |
| POST /fast | @cf/meta/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct | text | $0.002202 | Quick and capable |
| POST /smart | @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fast | text | $0.000946 | Reliable workhorse |
| POST /think | @cf/deepseek-ai/deepseek-r1-distill-qwen-32b | text | $0.012013 | Deep reasoning |
| POST /code | @cf/qwen/qwen2.5-coder-32b-instruct | text | $0.002794 | Code specialist |
| POST /big | @cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast | text | $0.005582 | Highest quality |
| POST /embed | @cf/baai/bge-m3 | embed | $0.000115 | Text embeddings |
| POST /image | @cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell | image | $0.002280 | Image generation |

Ceilings are computed from fixed worst-case assumptions, not from the request:

- text: 500 input tokens + 2,000 output tokens
- embed: 8,192 input tokens (max context)
- image: 1 generation, 1024x1024, 4 steps

#### OpenAI-Compatible Routes

| Route | Kind | maxPrice quoted | Default model |
|-------|------|-----------------|---------------|
| POST /v1/chat/completions | text | $0.012013 | nano |
| POST /v1/embeddings | embed | $0.000115 | embed |
| POST /v1/images/generations | image | $0.002280 | image |

These routes quote the **highest ceiling of their kind**, because the model is unknown until the request body is parsed. `POST /v1/chat/completions` with `{"model":"fast"}` therefore asks for $0.012013 of authorization, while `POST /fast` asks for $0.002202. Settlement meters down to the resolved model's real cost either way, so the charge is the same — but the wallet allowance required differs. Use the short-name routes when the authorization amount matters.

An unrecognised `model` value does not 404: `resolveModel` silently falls back to the route's default model (`nano` for chat, `embed`, `image`) and bills at that model's rate.

#### Limits

- **No streaming.** `stream: true` is ignored; the response is always a single JSON body. An OpenAI SDK expecting `text/event-stream` will fail.
- **`POST /v1/images/generations` returns raw PNG bytes** with `Content-Type: image/png` — not OpenAI's `{"created":…,"data":[{"b64_json":…}]}` envelope.
- **Unknown model names fall back silently** (see above).

#### Request Format

```json
POST /fast
Content-Type: application/json
PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <base64-encoded signed payment payload>

{
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
  "max_tokens": 512,
  "temperature": 0.7
}
```

#### Response Format (OpenAI-compatible)

```json
{
  "id": "chatcmpl-...",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "model": "fast",
  "choices": [{
    "index": 0,
    "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "..."},
    "finish_reason": "stop"
  }],
  "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 10, "completion_tokens": 50, "total_tokens": 60}
}
```

#### Pricing

Retail = wholesale × 1.20. Wholesale = Cloudflare Workers AI neurons × $0.000011 per neuron. The margin is `DEFAULT_MARGIN_BPS = 2000` (2,000 basis points) in `@x402cloud/middleware`. **There is no base fee and no subscription minimum.** The smallest amount that can move on-chain is 1 micro-USDC ($0.000001).

What each kind meters on differs, and the difference is material:

| Kind | Metered on | Ceiling vs charge |
|------|-----------|-------------------|
| text (nano, fast, smart, think, code, big) | `usage.prompt_tokens` + `usage.completion_tokens` from the model response; falls back to a `ceil(chars / 4)` estimate if the runtime returns no `usage` | charge is usually well below the ceiling |
| embed | `ceil(input.length / 4)` characters of the request — a character estimate, not model-reported tokens | charge is usually well below the ceiling |
| image | a constant 172.8 neurons per generation | **charge always equals the ceiling** ($0.002280) — the ceiling is derived from the same constant, so `image` is a flat per-image price, not metered |

### facilitator.x402cloud.ai — Payment Facilitator

Hosted payment verification and USDC settlement service. Used by x402 middleware to verify payments and settle on-chain without servers needing private keys.

- **Base URL**: `https://facilitator.x402cloud.ai`
- **Networks served**: Base Sepolia (`eip155:84532`) only — `GET /supported` returns `{"schemes":["exact","upto"],"networks":["eip155:84532"],"facilitator":"0x207C…8E88"}`
- **Facilitator address**: `0x207C6D8f63Bf01F70dc6D372693E8D5943848E88`
- **Service docs**: https://facilitator.x402cloud.ai/llms.txt

#### Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Auth | Description |
|----------|--------|------|-------------|
| / | GET | No | Service info and endpoint listing |
| /health | GET | No | Health check — returns `{"status":"ok"}` |
| /supported | GET | No | Supported schemes, networks, and facilitator address |
| /verify | POST | Bearer token | Verify an `upto` payment payload against requirements |
| /settle | POST | Bearer token | Settle a verified `upto` payment on-chain via Permit2 |
| /verify-exact | POST | Bearer token | Verify an `exact` payment payload |
| /settle-exact | POST | Bearer token | Settle a verified `exact` payment on-chain |

Response shapes: verify returns `{"isValid":true,"payer":"0x…"}` or `{"isValid":false,"invalidReason":"…"}`; settle returns `{"success":true,"transaction":"0x…","network":"eip155:84532","settledAmount":"…"}` or `{"success":false,"errorReason":"…"}`, and may return HTTP 202 with `"pending":true` while a broadcast awaits confirmation.

## npm Packages

All packages are published under the `@x402cloud` npm scope. Install what you need:

### @x402cloud/protocol

Core types and header encoding for the x402 protocol. Zero dependencies.

```
npm install @x402cloud/protocol
```

Exports:
- **Types**: `Network`, `Scheme`, `PaymentRequirements`, `PaymentRequired`, `PaymentPayload`, `VerifyResponse`, `SettleResponse`, `MeterFunction`, `RouteConfig`, `RoutesConfig`
- **Header functions**: `encodePaymentHeader`, `decodePaymentHeader`, `encodeRequirementsHeader`, `decodeRequirementsHeader`, `extractPaymentHeader`
- **USDC utilities**: `parseUsdcAmount`, `formatUsdcAmount`
- **Model registry**: `MODEL_REGISTRY`, `modelKeysOfType`, `ModelType`, `ModelEntry`, `ModelKey`

### @x402cloud/evm

EVM payment scheme implementations using Permit2. Supports "exact" (fixed price) and "upto" (metered) payment schemes.

```
npm install @x402cloud/evm
```

Exports:
- **Upto scheme**: `createUptoPayload`, `verifyUpto`, `settleUpto`
- **Exact scheme**: `createExactPayload`, `verifyExact`, `settleExact`
- **Types**: `UptoPayload`, `ExactPayload`, `Permit2Authorization`, `Permit2Witness`, `ClientSigner`, `VerifySigner`, `FacilitatorSigner`
- **Constants**: Permit2 address, ABI, contract addresses
- **Utilities**: `parseChainId`

### @x402cloud/client

Client SDK that auto-pays HTTP 402 responses. Wraps `fetch()` to transparently handle payment negotiation.

```
npm install @x402cloud/client
```

Exports:
- `wrapFetchWithPayment(config)` — Wraps fetch to auto-pay 402 responses
- **Types**: `PaymentClientConfig`, `SchemeHandler`

Usage:
```typescript
import { wrapFetchWithPayment } from "@x402cloud/client";
import { createWalletClient, http } from "viem";
import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
import { baseSepolia } from "viem/chains";

// infer.x402cloud.ai settles on Base Sepolia (eip155:84532). The wallet needs
// Base Sepolia test USDC and a one-time Permit2 approval on that same chain.
const account = privateKeyToAccount("0xYOUR_PRIVATE_KEY");
const walletClient = createWalletClient({ account, chain: baseSepolia, transport: http() });

const x402Fetch = wrapFetchWithPayment({ signer: walletClient });

const response = await x402Fetch("https://infer.x402cloud.ai/fast", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({ messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Hello" }] }),
});
```

### @x402cloud/middleware

Hono server middleware for x402 payment gating. Add micropayments to any Hono API.

```
npm install @x402cloud/middleware
```

Exports:
- `uptoPaymentMiddleware` — Local middleware (verifies payments directly)
- `remoteUptoPaymentMiddleware` — Remote middleware (delegates to a facilitator URL)
- `buildUptoMiddleware` — Low-level middleware builder
- `buildPaymentRequired` — Build 402 response manually
- **Types**: `UptoRouteConfig`, `UptoRoutesConfig`, `VerifyFn`, `SettleFn`

Usage with hosted facilitator. This example gates a third party's own API and uses Base mainnet (`eip155:8453`) as an illustration of route config — it is not a description of x402cloud's own services, which run on Base Sepolia only:
```typescript
import { Hono } from "hono";
import { remoteUptoPaymentMiddleware } from "@x402cloud/middleware";

const app = new Hono();

app.use("/*", remoteUptoPaymentMiddleware({
  "POST /api/generate": {
    network: "eip155:8453",
    maxPrice: "$0.01",
    payTo: "0xYOUR_WALLET_ADDRESS",
    description: "AI text generation",
  }
}, "https://facilitator.x402cloud.ai"));

app.post("/api/generate", async (c) => {
  // This code only runs after payment is verified
  return c.json({ result: "..." });
});
```

### @x402cloud/facilitator

Facilitator core for verifying and settling x402 payments on-chain. Use this to run your own facilitator.

```
npm install @x402cloud/facilitator
```

Exports:
- `createFacilitator` — Create a facilitator instance
- **Types**: `FacilitatorConfig`, `Facilitator`

Usage:
```typescript
import { createFacilitator } from "@x402cloud/facilitator";
import { base } from "viem/chains";

const facilitator = createFacilitator({
  privateKey: "0xFACILITATOR_PRIVATE_KEY",
  rpcUrl: "https://mainnet.base.org",
  network: "eip155:8453",
  chain: base,
});

// Verify a payment
const result = await facilitator.verify(payload, requirements);

// Settle on-chain
const settlement = await facilitator.settle(payload, requirements, settlementAmount);
```

## Contract Addresses

| Contract | Address | Networks |
|----------|---------|----------|
| Permit2 | `0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3` | All EVM chains |
| USDC (Base) | `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913` | Base mainnet |
| USDC (Base Sepolia) | `0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e` | Base Sepolia |
| x402 Upto Proxy | `0x4020A4f3b7b90ccA423B9fabCc0CE57C6C240002` | Base mainnet AND Base Sepolia (same address) |
| x402 Exact Proxy | `0x402085c248EeA27D92E8b30b2C58ed07f9E20001` | Base mainnet AND Base Sepolia (same address) |

The two proxies are the canonical Coinbase contracts, deployed by deterministic CREATE2, so the address is identical on Base mainnet (`eip155:8453`) and Base Sepolia (`eip155:84532`). Source of truth in this repo: `packages/evm/src/constants.ts` (`X402_UPTO_PROXY`, `X402_EXACT_PROXY`), pinned by `packages/evm/test/proxy-addresses.test.ts`.

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────┐     ┌──────────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────────┐
│  Agent / Client  │────▶│  Your API + middleware│────▶│  Facilitator        │
│  @x402cloud/     │◀────│  @x402cloud/         │◀────│  @x402cloud/        │
│  client          │     │  middleware           │     │  facilitator        │
└─────────────────┘     └──────────────────────┘     └─────────────────────┘
        │                         │                           │
        │ Signs Permit2           │ Verifies payment          │ Settles on-chain
        │ (off-chain)             │ via facilitator            │ via Permit2
        ▼                         ▼                           ▼
   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
   │                    Base (EVM) — USDC                         │
   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
